KKR.title: KKR reopens Lending Partners shelf with $624 million static CLO
KKR.titleZh: KKR重启Lending Partners系列，发行6.24亿美元静态CLO
KKR.summary: KKR priced a $624 million static private-credit CLO under its Lending Partners shelf, according to Private Credit Daily citing Creditflux. The vehicle uses an existing fixed pool of loans and pays down as assets mature, rather than relying on a reinvestment period. For credit investors, the structure is relevant because it converts seasoned direct-lending exposure into rated term funding during a thinner origination market.
KKR.summaryZh: 据Private Credit Daily援引Creditflux报道，KKR在其Lending Partners系列下完成一笔6.24亿美元静态私募信贷CLO的定价。该产品采用既有的固定贷款资产池，随资产到期逐步偿还，而非依赖再投资期。对信贷投资者而言，该结构值得关注，因为它在新增放贷较为清淡的市场环境下，将已有一定存续期的直接贷款敞口转化为具评级的定期融资。

KKR.title: Apollo and KKR partner around Atlantic Aviation at a nearly $10 billion valuation
KKR.titleZh: Apollo与KKR携手合作Atlantic Aviation，估值近$10 billion
KKR.summary: Apollo-managed funds acquired a significant interest in Atlantic Aviation while KKR-managed funds remained a substantial shareholder, valuing the US aviation infrastructure platform at nearly $10 billion. The company operates fixed-base aviation infrastructure, including fueling, hangar leasing, and airport concession-backed services. Although this is an equity/infrastructure transaction, it is relevant to aircraft and aviation-linked collateral themes watched by private credit investors.
KKR.summaryZh: Apollo管理的基金收购了Atlantic Aviation的重大权益，KKR管理的基金仍为其主要股东，此次交易对这家美国航空基础设施平台的估值近$10 billion。该公司运营固定基地运营（FBO）航空基础设施，包括加油、机库租赁以及以机场特许经营权为支撑的服务。尽管这是一笔股权/基础设施交易，但与私募信贷投资者关注的飞机及航空相关抵押品主题相关。

Blue Owl.summary: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. closed a $150 million private placement of 7.60% senior unsecured notes due 2032, bringing debt financing raised since June 30 to $800 million. PAG.summary: Australian property developer Bathla Group remains a stress point after entering administration, with reports identifying multiple private-credit lenders and funds exposed to the group. ABC reporting said a short-term funding package involved several lenders including PAG, while other coverage described redemption limits and wider pressure across exposed funds. This is outside the core US/Europe region mix, but it is included because PAG is on the tracked GP list and the episode is directly tied to real estate private credit and fund liquidity risk.

PAG.title: Pagaya Closes 100th Asset-Backed Securitization with New $650 Million Auto ABS Deal
PAG.titleZh: Pagaya完成第100笔资产支持证券化交易，新发6.5亿美元汽车ABS
PAG.summary: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Pagaya Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: PGY) (“Pagaya”), a global technology company delivering AI-driven product solutions for the financial ecosystem, today announced the closing of RPM 2026-5, a $650 million asset-backed securitization backed by auto loans. This landmark transaction represents Pagaya's 100th ABS deal since the Company's first securitization in 2018.
PAG.summaryZh: 纽约--(美国商业资讯)--Pagaya Technologies Ltd.（NASDAQ: PGY）（“Pagaya”）是一家为金融生态系统提供AI驱动产品解决方案的全球科技公司，今日宣布完成RPM 2026-5的发行。这是一笔以汽车贷款为基础资产、规模为6.5亿美元的资产支持证券化交易。这一里程碑式交易是Pagaya自2018年首次证券化以来完成的第100笔ABS交易。
PAG.lede: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Pagaya Technologies Ltd. Many will say that any AI Agent should proclaim, “I am an AI Agent,” and anything from a bot should proclaim, “I am from a bot.” Would you let an “AI Agent” manage your money?

Your auditors stay in control, confirming findings instead of redoing them. With AuditGenius | ai, our own prefunding QA review times dropped from up to 2 hours to about 15 minutes. One review instead of two. Revolutionary, we know. Request a demo of AuditGenius | ai.”

Guggenheim.title: Pizza Hut targets $1bn securitisation to refinance LongRange buyout
Guggenheim.titleZh: Pizza Hut拟通过10亿美元证券化为LongRange收购融资再融资
Guggenheim.summary: Pizza Hut is preparing to raise approximately $1bn through an asset-backed bond offering to refinance debt associated with its acquisition by private equity firm LongRange Capital, according to a report by Bloomberg. The proposed financing will reportedly take the form of a whole-business securitisation, backed by franchise agreements, royalty payments, advertising fees, vendor rebates and intellectual property. The offering includes at least $600m of bonds alongside a separately marketed tranche, with an expected average life of approximately 4.8 years.
Guggenheim.summaryZh: 据Bloomberg报道，Pizza Hut正准备通过资产支持债券发行募集约10亿美元，用于对其被私募股权公司LongRange Capital收购相关的债务进行再融资。据悉，拟议融资将采用全业务证券化形式，以特许经营协议、特许权使用费、广告费、供应商返利及知识产权作为支持。此次发行包括至少6亿美元债券以及一个单独营销的分级，预期平均期限约为4.8年。
Guggenheim.lede: Pizza Hut is preparing to raise approximately $1bn through an asset-backed bond offering to refinance debt associated with its acquisition by private equity firm LongRange Capital, according to a report by Bloomberg. The proposed financing will reportedly take the form of a whole-business securitisation, backed by franchise agreements, royalty payments, advertising fees, vendor rebates and intellectual property. The offering includes at least $600m of bonds alongside a separately marketed tranche, with an expected average life of approximately 4.8 years. The bonds are expected to price at yields between two and three percentage points above benchmark rates and have received BBB ratings from S&P Global Ratings and Kroll Bond Rating Agency. Proceeds will primarily refinance acquisition-related debt, cover transaction expenses and fund an interest reserve, with any remaining capital available for strategic investments in the US and Canada. Pizza Hut operates a predominantly franchised model, with approximately 99% of restaurants run by franchisees. Its US and Canadian network comprises more than 6,675 locations, generating approximately $5.4bn in systemwide sales over the 12 months to the second quarter of 2026. UBS is leading the bond offering, with Barclays, Bank of America, Guggenheim Securities and Rabo Securities among the bookrunners.

items.title: Pizza Hut targets $1bn securitisation to refinance LongRange buyout
items.titleZh: Pizza Hut拟通过10亿美元证券化为LongRange收购融资再融资
items.summary: Pizza Hut is preparing to raise approximately $1bn through an asset-backed bond offering to refinance debt associated with its acquisition by private equity firm LongRange Capital, according to a report by Bloomberg. The proposed financing will reportedly take the form of a whole-business securitisation, backed by franchise agreements, royalty payments, advertising fees, vendor rebates and intellectual property. The offering includes at least $600m of bonds alongside a separately marketed tranche, with an expected average life of approximately 4.8 years.
items.summaryZh: 据Bloomberg报道，Pizza Hut正准备通过资产支持债券发行募集约10亿美元，用于对其被私募股权公司LongRange Capital收购相关的债务进行再融资。据悉，拟议融资将采用全业务证券化形式，以特许经营协议、特许权使用费、广告费、供应商返利及知识产权作为支持。此次发行包括至少6亿美元债券以及一个单独营销的分级，预期平均期限约为4.8年。
items.lede: Pizza Hut is preparing to raise approximately $1bn through an asset-backed bond offering to refinance debt associated with its acquisition by private equity firm LongRange Capital, according to a report by Bloomberg. The proposed financing will reportedly take the form of a whole-business securitisation, backed by franchise agreements, royalty payments, advertising fees, vendor rebates and intellectual property. The offering includes at least $600m of bonds alongside a separately marketed tranche, with an expected average life of approximately 4.8 years. The bonds are expected to price at yields between two and three percentage points above benchmark rates and have received BBB ratings from S&P Global Ratings and Kroll Bond Rating Agency. Proceeds will primarily refinance acquisition-related debt, cover transaction expenses and fund an interest reserve, with any remaining capital available for strategic investments in the US and Canada. Pizza Hut operates a predominantly franchised model, with approximately 99% of restaurants run by franchisees. Its US and Canadian network comprises more than 6,675 locations, generating approximately $5.4bn in systemwide sales over the 12 months to the second quarter of 2026. UBS is leading the bond offering, with Barclays, Bank of America, Guggenheim Securities and Rabo Securities among the bookrunners.
